snippet.title: Nanatsu No Hikan [PS1] (1995) - Gameplay
snippet.description:
Gameplay footage of Koei's Nanatsu No Hikan (1995).

I found out about this this game while searching through the Koei Wiki. I couldn't find any gameplay footage on YouTube, so I decided to try and record a video of it.

Since I don't know Japanese, I couldn't make much sense of the menus, and I didn't make much progress. I ended up stumbling into finding a secret room and and I think an item. I got a Game Over screen by walking towards the knight about a dozen times. The game's got a health system, and it seems pretty generous.

It's a shame it didn't get translated, since it seems like it's a pretty interesting game.

There was a sequel for Dreamcast (Nanatsu no Hikan: Senritsu no Bishou), but it was a survival-horror game rather than a adventure game.

If you want to read about the game in-depth, here's the article about it on the Koei Wiki: http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Nanatsu_no_Hikan
